subject: apps/api/src/coach/native-context.test.ts
because: The Coach finds a Paper through paper.list and the Word read instead of paper.get; the fakes now answer paper.list, and every refusal case is unchanged, including the missing native basis.

subject: apps/api/src/one-door.test.ts
because: GET /api/paper/:id is deleted with paper.get, so it leaves the waiting-route list and the list cap drops from 6 to 5.

subject: apps/api/src/paper/content-rich-http.test.ts
because: The old GET /api/paper/:id read is deleted with paper.get; the refused sync before it still proves nothing is written.

subject: apps/api/src/paper/content-rich.test.ts
because: paper.get is deleted; the case still proves a refused rich sync writes nothing and records no activity.

subject: apps/api/src/paper/package-list.test.ts
because: paper.get is deleted; the owner reads a Word page's identity through paper.read with view info, and the Coach reads its text through paper.outline, which the case already checks.

subject: apps/api/src/paper/package-proposal.test.ts
because: paper.get is deleted, so its not-found check for a person reading a Word page has no subject; the Coach grounding checks stay.

subject: apps/api/src/paper/word-card-actions.test.ts
because: paper.get is deleted; the Coach's reads of a deleted and a live Word page now go through paper.outline with the same not-found and text checks.

subject: apps/api/src/registry/behavior.test.ts
because: paper.get is no longer a Coach tool, so it leaves the expected Coach tool list.

subject: apps/api/src/registry/invalidation.formal.test.ts
because: paper.get and paper.document are gone; their snapshots move to paper.read with view info, and the Coach document read half of the page-write case has no subject left.

subject: apps/web/src/features/coach/coach-progress.test.ts
because: The progress fold examples name paper.read, which carries the same Read your Paper label, instead of the removed paper.get.

subject: apps/web/src/lib/paper-qualification.test.ts
because: The qualified paper.get read is deleted; the basis, writer, key and cancellation cases now run against the qualified paper.list read with the same expectations.
